selection: None: no retraining, threshold selection, site selection, magnitude selection or case filtering after freeze.
canonical_format: Original study renderer normalizes positive action descriptions using the class annotation. This preserves the prior benchmark protocol and is reported separately.
original_actions_format: Same prompt wrapper, but original action wording is retained for every class. STOP/KEEP indices come only from audited semantic annotations, never from predictions.
cache: Identical tokenized prompts and conditions may reuse deterministic scores across formats; report logical views and actual forwards separately.
generation: New synthetic cases drafted without controller scores or prior case texts, audited before inference. Not independent human adjudication; not claimed to cover entirely novel mechanisms.
reporting: Keep all frozen cases and results, report raw and guarded behavior, subtype/order effects, detector errors, and baseline STOP counts. Never silently replace weak cases or retune from results.
